modes.baseline: Request all available history for each selected symbol.
modes.sync: Request new history plus a configurable overlap; symbols without a baseline automatically receive a full request.
modes.refresh-flagged: Request complete history only for symbols flagged by corporate-action, adjusted-history, or missing-bar changes.

change_policy.revised_bars: replace current row and preserve old/new values in bar_revisions
change_policy.missing_bars: record MISSING_FROM_REFRESH and retain the stored bar
change_policy.new_or_revised_corporate_actions: preserve event change and flag symbol for full refresh

baseline_request_policy.reason: Explicit period bounds prevent Yahoo range=max from silently returning a coarser granularity.
baseline_request_policy.granularity_validation: Returned meta.dataGranularity must equal the requested interval.
